correctness.rationale: Reviewed incidence-cycle model on 2n vertices, with faces independent incident-arc matchings except the two forbidden full alternating directed-cycle faces. Finite-group fixed barycentric coordinates must be constant on each vertex orbit; full-orbit unions, not merely individually fixed vertices, define the PL fixed model. Rotational quotient residues modulo 2t have exactly the smaller cycle incidences and the same two excluded alternating facets. In the reflecting case j maps to -1-j-2b, the t mirrored Q_i have inadmissible endpoint orbits i=0,t-1 and all remaining admissible orbits have incompatibility graph P_(t-2); each mixed-parity orbit avoids the two monochromatic forbidden full facets. The classical Ind(P_m) mod-three homotopy recurrence then gives sphere/point cases. Independently enumerated matching cycles and reflected/rotated orbit faces for 153 distinct (n,t,b) models through n<=12 (<=20 orbits), matching exact predicted faces; the all-n theorem rests on the orbit proof, not this finite scan.

value.rationale: The complete subgroup-fixed geometric topology of a natural infinite family of full ordinary Morse complexes is a meaningful equivariant refinement of classical nonequivariant wedge formulas. The exact path model distinguishes reflections from rotations and converts an infinite fixed-space classification to familiar tractable complexes; this is not routine substitution of a previously known nonequivariant formula.

final_claim: For n>=3 and each natural H<=D_n with rotation part <r^t>, |M(C_n)|^H is empty for t=1, four points for pure rotation t=2, PL-homeomorphic to M(C_t) for pure rotation t>=3, and, for reflection-containing H, empty t<=2 or PL-homeomorphic to Ind(P_(t-2)) t>=3, yielding the exact homotopy classifications.
limitations: Only natural dihedral action of underlying cycle on full ordinary Morse complex, not all abstract automorphisms or pure/strong complexes.
No quotient homotopy, Mackey functor, normalizer action or genuine equivariant stable classification is claimed.
residual_risks: A generic equivariant independent-set theorem for punctured cycle complexes could contain the same fixed-orbit identification under another name.
The mod-three path homotopy formula and ordinary cycle wedge decomposition are credited prior work, not independent new components.
